text:
sasha: Quick lunchtime poll — office bouldering wall for 30 mins 🧗‍♀️ or hop on the bike for a 5-mile roundtrip ride 🚲? Who's down?
jon: Boulder for me, can squeeze 25 mins between meetings.
maria: Bike this time, weather's too nice to waste.
kevin: boulder 😴 but I can only top-rope, no dynos.
anya: Bike + coffee stop? ☕️
lisa: If we do boulder, can someone bring a brush and tape? 
jon: I can bring a brush, and a spare tape strip.
sasha: Nice — if more people pick bike I can lock my bike in the rack near 3rd floor.
maria: Vote: BIKE :arrow_up:
kevin: BOULDER :arrow_up: (also I will clap if someone actually does a heel hook haha)
anya: Bike — I'll time it and try a negative split.
lisa: Boulder for me but only if we keep to 30m so I can shower.
jon: Can we combine? quick 15 at the wall then bike back?
sasha: Might be tight but doable if we start at 12:10.
kevin: Hmm ok, quick circuit then pedal sounds fun.
devbot: Reminder: 12:00–12:45 is booked in the east gym for 'team yoga' but the wall is free.
maria: Perfect — plan: 12:10 warmup, 12:15–12:40 climb, then anyone biking can head out at 12:45?
anya: I'm in. Bringing pump and a granola bar.
lisa: In for the short session. See y'all by the wall. :wave: 
sasha: Poll results (informal): Boulder 4, Bike 3 — leaning boulder + a few opt to bike after. See you at 12:10!
